positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development within the company's Mobile Engagement team.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and provided operations support for the big-data search analytics platform serving Amazon’s global operations.

Supported click-stream log ingest tools, developed the analytics component of the AWS CloudSearch service, new data set build processes, migration of data transport to AWS-based solutions, migration of data builds from data-center based Hadoop clusters to AWS Elastic Map Reduce clusters.

Java, Python, Hadoop/Pig, Amazon AWS, Linux OS.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed architecture and implemented infrastructure components for an over-the-air mobile device management and software delivery system. Developed in Java, Oracle, Tomcat and Unix technologies. Focus areas included security and multi-tenancy infrastructure, over-the-air device enrollment protocol, iPhone device management.

positions.title: Senior Architect
positions.description:
Software architecture and development of on-line request-for-bid system. 

Redesign and re-implementation of RFx system in C# on Microsoft ASP.Net and SQL Server. Developed security and multi-tenancy infrastructure.  Added contract management module. Executed customer systems integration. Twelve months serving as Architect for ASP.Net solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software architecture and development of on-line request-for-bid system. 

Developed a reverse auction-based automated RFx tool for use by corporations seeking to manage spend.  Implemented XML-based web-service integration layer using SOAP over HTTPS.  Technologies: J2EE, Apple WebObjects, Oracle, and Unix (delivery) and NT (development) OSs.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Software design and implementation of key components of an advanced secure internet platform.  Java on Unix.  Developed user/groups and access control objects repository with local and remote API bindings.  Subsequently architecture, requirements and design of IP network security infrastructure based on this platform for a new global telecommunications firm.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Joined Advanced Technology Group at its inception just after breakup of AT&T.  Built prototypes and trial vehicles for new services.  Interned at Bellcore (work in: computational lexicography, parallel programming language research, research oriented service control software architecture for broadband multi-media services)

Software Technology Laboratory group: developed early applications of ISDN in education (provided technology for field testing multi-site, multi-media networking within public schools); developed an on-line document delivery system deployed throughout engineering department.

Strategic Information Systems and later New Information Technology groups: prototyped elements of company-wide knowledge management system; developed components for order processing systems; ported Intelligent Tutoring System from stand-alone solution to Unix-based client/server architecture; principal technologist for internal web-based publishing systems.

Customer Care Applications, Emerging Technologies and Pacific Telesis Shared Services groups: Lead for deployment of company's internal web infrastructure, technical webmaster during initiation and build-out of www.pacbell.com; lead technical resource behind functional build-out of this Internet site (on-line order entry infrastructure and applications), built secure extra-net infrastructure.
